components.name: Start swap button
components.description: The only interactive control in the two-state motion study.
components.css: .ds-start-swap { width: 120px; height: 40px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--color-accent, #F50DB4); color: #FFFFFF; padding: 8px 12px; font: 600 16px/24px 'Open Runde', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em; transition: filter 200ms ease-out, transform 200ms ease-out; } .ds-start-swap:hover { filter: brightness(0.96); } .ds-start-swap:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #F9A4E1; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-start-swap:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

narrative.overview: A restrained white product canvas where a single magenta action becomes the spatial origin of a familiar swap preview.

rules.name: The One Action Rule
rules.body: Magenta communicates the primary action and is never decorative.

dos: Provide an immediate reduced-motion state change.
donts: Don't add generic Web3 gradients, neon-on-dark styling, glassmorphism, decorative crypto imagery, bounce, extra application chrome, or invented workflow states.
